# Captain Tracy Charter Fishing Website

This is a Next.js website for Captain Tracy's Gulf Coast charter fishing business focused on bringing families together through fishing experiences.

## Project Features

- Coming soon charter booking sales funnel
- Fishing reports and educational content
- Blog and vlog sections for SEO
- Family-focused messaging and design
- Mobile-responsive design
- SEO optimization for organic ranking

## Development Guidelines

- Focus on family-friendly design and messaging
- Prioritize SEO best practices
- Include lead capture forms for pre-launch marketing
- Create engaging content sections for fishing education
- Ensure mobile-first responsive design

## Content Strategy

- Educational fishing content for Gulf Coast waters
- Family bonding through fishing themes
- Regular fishing reports and conditions
- Video content for engagement
- Local SEO targeting Gulf Coast region
